purpose: Test a prediction-time gate between current v25 and the already rejected own-history HGB, without changing either frozen base prediction

gate.population: Fit only on gateFit rows with strictly-prior exact-own-sale evidence and both valid base predictions; predict on all cases
gate.target: One if frozen own-history prediction has lower absolute log error than frozen v25 on the gateFit event; zero otherwise; ties are zero
gate.model: StandardScaler plus LogisticRegression with C=0.25, max_iter=1000, lbfgs solver, random_state=17
gate.identityWeight: Each fit event receives inverse square root of its fit-window NFT event count
gate.blend: For eligible cases, use the predicted probability as a log-space geometric mixing weight for point, lower, and upper; use v25 unchanged without own evidence; use the available valid source on one-source cases

evaluation.pooledDecisionWindow: developmentCheck plus laterCheck; fit-window results are reported as in-sample diagnostics only
evaluation.uncertainty: 2000 deterministic NFT-identity-cluster bootstrap resamples for paired secondary-premium MALE improvement

interpretation: Exposed historical development only. A gate pass would not authorize production integration or current-market qualification; reserved prospective outcomes remain sealed.
